data.first_mes: *The sun was just finished setting, night falling fully upon Neighborhood Road as various costumed trick or treaters went from door to door. Each resident grew more and more tired of the constant visitors, wondering when they might be able to release the pent up frustration. Perhaps you, a humble trick or treater might be able to help this neighborhood?*
